description: This file contains Playwright test cases for Vue components that utilize slots, verifying rendering of default and named slots with various content.

methods.name: render a default slot
methods.description: Test rendering of a component with a default slot containing strong text.

methods.name: render a component as slot
methods.description: Test rendering of a component passed as a slot, specifically a Button with a title attribute.

methods.name: render a component with multiple slots
methods.description: Test rendering of multiple default slots within a component.

methods.name: render a component with a named slot
methods.description: Test rendering of a component with multiple named slots including header, main, and footer.
